create function [dbo].[zrf_GetKeyList]( @cField varchar(39) , @cList nvarchar(max) , @nType tinyint -- 0 ExactInlist, 1 - Inlist , @UniCode tinyint ) returns nvarchar(max) as begin declare @sRet nvarchar(max), @cUni varchar(1) set @cList = rtrim(ltrim(@cList)) set @cList = replace(@cList, '''', '''''')
while charindex(', ', @cList) > 0 begin set @cList = replace(@cList, ', ', ',') end
set @cUni = '' if @UniCode = 1 set @cUni = 'N'
if @nType = 0 begin set @sRet = @cField + ' in (' + @cUni + '''' + replace(@cList, ',', ''', ' + @cUni + '''') + ''')' end
if @nType = 1 begin if charindex(',', @cList) = 0 return @cField + ' like ' + @cUni + '''' + @cList + '%'''
set @sRet = '(' + @cField + ' like ' + @cUni + '''' + replace(@cList, ',', '%'' or ' + @cField + ' like ' + @cUni + '''') + '%'')' end
return @sRet end GO

-- Indexes DECLARE @table_name NVARCHAR(128), @table_schema NVARCHAR(128), @index_name NVARCHAR(128) DECLARE @sql_string VARCHAR(4000), @is_unique_constraint TINYINT, @is_uniqueindex TINYINT, @is_clustered TINYINT , @is_statistics TINYINT, @cnst_is_nottrusted TINYINT, @index_fillfactor TINYINT , @index_key_string NVARCHAR(1000), @filegroup_name NVARCHAR(128), @is_padindex TINYINT
DECLARE @sysindexes TABLE ( table_id INT , table_name NVARCHAR(128) , table_schema NVARCHAR(128) , index_name NVARCHAR(128) , index_id INT , index_key_string NVARCHAR(2048) , is_primary_key TINYINT , cnst_is_clustkey TINYINT , is_unique_constraint TINYINT , index_fillfactor TINYINT , is_clustered TINYINT , is_statistics TINYINT , is_auto_statistics TINYINT , is_hypothetical TINYINT , is_padindex TINYINT , is_uniqueindex TINYINT , is_pagelock_disallowed TINYINT , is_rowlock_disallowed TINYINT , cnst_is_nonclustkey TINYINT , cnst_is_nottrusted TINYINT , [filegroup_id] INT , [filegroup_name] NVARCHAR(128) )
INSERT INTO @sysindexes SELECT DISTINCT si.id , Object_name(si.id) , User_Name(ObjectProperty(si.id, 'OwnerId')) , si.name , si.indid , '' , Coalesce(ObjectProperty(OBJECT_ID(si.name), 'IsPrimaryKey'), 0) , NULL -- Coalesce(ObjectProperty(Object_id(si.name), 'CnstIsClustKey'), 0) , NULL -- Coalesce(ObjectProperty(Object_id(si.name), 'IsUniqueCnst'), 0) , Coalesce(IndexProperty(si.id, si.name, 'IndexFillFactor'), 0) , Coalesce(IndexProperty(si.id, si.name, 'IsClustered'), 0) , NULL -- Coalesce(IndexProperty(si.id, si.name, 'IsStatistics'), 0) , NULL -- Coalesce(IndexProperty(si.id, si.name, 'IsAutoStatistics'), 0) , NULL -- Coalesce(IndexProperty(si.id, si.name, 'IsHypothetical'), 0) , Coalesce(IndexProperty(si.id, si.name, 'IsPadIndex'), 0) , Coalesce(IndexProperty(si.id, si.name, 'IsUnique'), 0) , NULL -- Coalesce(IndexProperty(si.id, si.name, 'IsPageLockDisallowed'), 0) , NULL -- Coalesce(IndexProperty(si.id, si.name, 'IsRowLockDisallowed'), 0) , NULL -- Coalesce(ObjectProperty(si.id, 'CnstIsNonclustKey'), 0) , NULL -- Coalesce(ObjectProperty(si.id, 'CnstIsNotTrusted'), 0) , groupid , '' FROM syscolumns sc JOIN sysobjects so ON so.id = sc.id JOIN sysindexes si ON si.id = so.id JOIN sysindexkeys sk ON sk.id = so.id AND sk.indid = si.indid AND sk.colid = sc.colid JOIN @tbl_main t ON so.name = t.table_name AND sc.name = t.column_name WHERE objectproperty(si.id, 'TableHasIndex') = 1 AND si.indid > 0 AND si.indid < 255 AND indexproperty(si.id, si.name, 'IsStatistics') = 0
UPDATE @sysindexes SET [filegroup_name] = b.groupname FROM @sysindexes a JOIN sysfilegroups b ON a.[filegroup_id] = b.groupid
UPDATE @sysindexes SET index_key_string = b.index_key_string FROM @sysindexes a JOIN ( SELECT so0.id AS table_id, si0.indid AS index_id , STUFF((SELECT ', [' + sc.name + ']' + CASE WHEN indexkey_property(so.id, si.indid, sk.keyno, 'IsDescending') = 1 THEN ' DESC' ELSE '' END FROM syscolumns sc JOIN sysobjects so ON so.id = sc.id JOIN sysindexes si ON si.id = so.id JOIN sysindexkeys sk ON sk.id = so.id AND sk.indid = si.indid AND sk.colid = sc.colid WHERE so.id = so0.id AND si.indid = si0.indid ORDER BY sk.keyno FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE ).value('.', 'NVARCHAR(MAX)') , 1, 2, '') AS index_key_string FROM sysobjects so0 JOIN sysindexes si0 ON si0.id = so0.id GROUP BY so0.id, si0.indid ) b ON a.table_id = b.table_id AND a.index_id = b.index_id WHERE NOT b.index_key_string IS NULL

DECLARE @i_drop TABLE (script NVARCHAR(4000)) DECLARE @i_create TABLE (script NVARCHAR(4000))
DECLARE xcur CURSOR FOR SELECT table_name, table_schema, index_name, is_unique_constraint, is_uniqueindex, is_clustered, is_statistics, index_key_string, cnst_is_nottrusted, index_fillfactor, [filegroup_name], is_padindex FROM @sysindexes OPEN xcur FETCH NEXT FROM xcur INTO @table_name, @table_schema, @index_name, @is_unique_constraint, @is_uniqueindex, @is_clustered, @is_statistics, @index_key_string, @cnst_is_nottrusted, @index_fillfactor, @filegroup_name, @is_padindex WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN INSERT INTO @i_drop SELECT 'DROP INDEX [' + @table_schema + '].[' + @table_name + '].[' + @index_name + ']' + @cLine + 'GO'
SET @sql_string = 'CREATE ' IF @is_uniqueindex = 1 SET @sql_string = @sql_string + 'UNIQUE ' IF @is_clustered = 1 SET @sql_string = @sql_string + 'CLUSTERED ' SET @sql_string = @sql_string + 'INDEX [' + @index_name + '] ON [' + @table_schema + '].[' + @table_name + '] (' + @index_key_string + ')' IF @is_padindex = 1 IF CHARINDEX('WITH', @sql_string) <> 0 SET @sql_string = @sql_string + ', PAD_INDEX ' ELSE SET @sql_string = @sql_string + 'WITH PAD_INDEX ' IF @index_fillfactor <> 0 IF CHARINDEX('WITH', @sql_string) <> 0 SET @sql_string = @sql_string + ', FILLFACTOR = ' + LTRIM(STR(@index_fillfactor)) ELSE SET @sql_string = @sql_string + 'WITH FILLFACTOR = ' + LTRIM(STR(@index_fillfactor)) IF NOT @filegroup_name IS NULL SET @sql_string = @sql_string + ' ON [' + @filegroup_name + ']' + @cLine + 'GO'
INSERT INTO @i_create SELECT @sql_string
FETCH NEXT FROM xcur INTO @table_name, @table_schema, @index_name, @is_unique_constraint, @is_uniqueindex, @is_clustered, @is_statistics, @index_key_string, @cnst_is_nottrusted, @index_fillfactor, @filegroup_name, @is_padindex END CLOSE xcur DEALLOCATE xcur

DECLARE iCur CURSOR FOR SELECT drop_c FROM @tdrop UNION ALL SELECT script FROM @i_drop UNION ALL SELECT 'ALTER TABLE [' + a.table_schema + '].[' + a.table_name + '] ALTER COLUMN [' + a.column_name + '] ' + RTRIM(UPPER(t.new_column_data)) + CASE WHEN c.isnullable = 1 THEN ' NULL' ELSE ' NOT NULL' END + @cLine + 'GO' AS script -- , a.table_schema, a.table_name, a.column_name, CAST(c.isnullable AS BIT) AS isnullable FROM information_schema.columns a LEFT JOIN information_schema.key_column_usage b ON a.table_name = b.table_name AND a.table_schema = b.table_schema AND a.column_name = b.column_name JOIN ( SELECT b.name AS table_name, c.name AS table_schema, a.name AS column_name, a.isnullable FROM syscolumns a JOIN sysobjects b ON a.id = b.id JOIN sysusers c ON b.uid = c.uid WHERE objectproperty(b.id, 'IsUserTable') = 1 ) c ON a.table_name = c.table_name AND a.table_schema = c.table_schema AND a.column_name = c.column_name JOIN @tbl_main t ON a.table_schema = t.table_schema AND a.table_name = t.table_name AND a.column_name = t.column_name UNION ALL SELECT add_u FROM @taddu WHERE 1 = 1 UNION ALL SELECT add_f FROM @taddf WHERE 1 = 1 UNION ALL SELECT script FROM @i_create WHERE 1 = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'exec sp_refreshview N''dbo.' + name + '''' FROM sysobjects WHERE xtype IN ('V') UNION ALL SELECT script FROM @s_ex OPEN iCur FETCH NEXT FROM iCur INTO @sql_string WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0 BEGIN PRINT @sql_string FETCH NEXT FROM iCur INTO @sql_string END CLOSE iCur DEALLOCATE iCur
